manifest.build: mbx build --release -p sparkles-server with MBX_LEARNED_INCREMENTAL=false on the laptop
manifest.stores: A on stores loaded by the base build, B on stores loaded by the candidate (b150d225, whose statistics the candidate writes identically)

method: abtime.py: per workload 4 rounds of A, B, B, A, each a fresh server pinned to CPUs 0-11 with RAYON_NUM_THREADS=12 and the result cache off, an idle-priority spinner on each server CPU and on the client CPU 12, 3 warm-ups and 20 timed requests per query and process; time is the server's planMs + execMs, medians over all requests and per round
scale: synthetic 1.05M, WatDiv 100, BSBM 10M explore and BI, LUBM(10) with OWL RL, DBpedia 8.2M-triple slice
